motion_vocabulary.motion: Line-masked rise: each headline line clips inside an overflow-hidden wrapper and translates from y:110% to y:0 with opacity 1 throughout (no fade); lede/actions/stats follow with a soft y:16px + unblur (filter: blur(6px) → 0). Word-slot keeps its existing y-cycle. Exit: content parallaxes out via existing scrollY springs (stiffness 55/80) — no opacity wipe of the whole hero.
motion_vocabulary.easing: cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1) (--ease-expo); word cycle spring stiffness 120 damping 22

motion_vocabulary.motion: Editorial column reveal: the h2 rises 24px AND unblurs (blur 8px→0), body copy fades in place (opacity 0→1, no y). Long-form pull quotes get a 1px left-rule that scaleY(0)→scaleY(1) from top origin over the same window.

Fold-open: folded panel rotates from rotateX(-8deg) + opacity 0.4 to flat, driven by ScrollTrigger scrub (smoothing 0.6), NOT a one-shot spring; attribution text slides 12px right in sync. Mobile items: simple staggered y:14px rise, 40ms apart.
motion_vocabulary.easing: scrub-linked linear with power2.inOut interpolation; entrance portion cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)

motion_vocabulary.surface_role: cards / grids (news cards, work cards, membership cards, board grid)
motion_vocabulary.motion: Grid stagger only: each card translateY(28px)→0 + opacity 0→1, 60ms apart, duration 500ms. No per-card scale, no blur. Hover: existing translateY(-0.35rem) on feature, translateX(0.3rem) on stream rows is kept; image scale 1.045 kept. REMOVE the 150ms/0.7s power2 'efsw-reveal-group' tween and let the stagger be the only entrance.

Underline sweep only: scaleX(0)→scaleX(1), transform-origin right→left on hover, 220ms. Active pill: background-color crossfade 220ms, NO transform. Mobile sheet keeps its translateY(100%)→0 at 500ms --ease-out; links inside stagger 30ms with y:10px rise. Header shows/hides on scroll via transform translateY only (spring stiffness 300 damping 30), never opacity.

motion_vocabulary.surface_role: form feedback (member form, auth, admin drawers, toasts)
motion_vocabulary.motion: Micro-confirmations only: invalid field → border-color to --efsw-danger 180ms + 4px translateX shake keyframe (2 cycles, 180ms total) on the label; success → button content crossfades to check icon (opacity, 200ms) and toast slides up translateY(0.5rem)→0 260ms. Drawer keeps efswAdminDrawerIn (translateX 1.5rem→0, 360ms). No full-form fades.

motion_vocabulary.surface_role: footer / CTA band (efsw-footer, content-cta, join band)
motion_vocabulary.motion: Single slow rise: translateY(50px)→0 + opacity, 1000ms, one per viewport entry — no stagger, no per-child animation. The big CTA h2 (up to clamp 6.5rem) may add a letter-spacing settle: -0.035em → -0.03em over the same 1000ms for a 'lock-in' feel.

peak_moments.name: DeanMessage — Portrait Kerning Wobble
peak_moments.description: On DeanMessage portrait scroll-in, the paired h2/name text runs a one-shot letter-spacing wobble: -0.06em → -0.02em → -0.03em over 700ms with --ease-back cubic-bezier(0.6,-0.28,0.735,0.045), while the portrait itself does clip-path inset(8% 8% 8% 8% round 50%) → inset(0 0 0 0 round 50%) over 900ms --ease-out. Fires once per portrait via ScrollTrigger once:true; scrub=false. This is the page's single 'authored' moment — everything else on the section stays still.

peak_moments.name: Newsroom Masthead — Scroll-Driven Beam Sweep
peak_moments.description: efsw-newsroom-masthead h1 sits under a 1px gradient beam (--efsw-gradient-line: mint→teal→sun) whose background-position-x is scrubbed from 0% to 100% across the masthead's own 60vh scroll range (ScrollTrigger scrub 0.5, smoothing in the 0.3–0.8 budget). The h1 letters stay static — only the beam and a matching 0.04em letter-spacing tightening on the last 20% of scrub move. Ties directly into the existing aurora-beam visual language of the hero.

peak_moments.name: About Reach Stats — Counter Draw-In
peak_moments.description: efsw-reach-stat strong values (clamp 3rem–7rem, weight 700, tabular-nums) count from 0 to their final integer over 1200ms with --ease-expo-out, triggered once at 75% viewport entry; the paired rule line beneath each stat scaleX(0)→scaleX(1) 800ms --ease-out 150ms later. Values render with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums throughout so digits don't jitter during the count. Reduced-motion: snap to final value, no tween.

patterns_to_delete: The universal heroContainer/heroItem spring-up (opacity 0, y:34, stiffness 280 damping 20) reused verbatim on non-hero sections — it is the single authored moment for the hero ONLY.

GSAP .efsw-reveal blanket tween (opacity 0, y:40, 800ms power3.out) applied to every section — replace with the surface-specific vocabulary; today the footer, labels, about h2, news h2 and every band all share the identical move.
.efsw-reveal-group card stagger at 150ms / 0.7s power2.out — redundant second system layered on top of .efsw-reveal; keep ONE card stagger at 60ms.

@keyframes fadeRise + .animate-fade-rise / -delay / -delay-2 (0.8s ease-out, translateY 20px) — a third duplicate of the same spring-up; delete the class trio and migrate remaining users to the vocabulary.
@keyframes subtleFloat (14s infinite alternate translateY -8px scale 1.03) — ambient float fights Lenis scroll smoothing and reads as noise on dark petrol; remove or demote to a 1-iteration entrance.

Duplicate CSS variable definitions: :root declares --font-display/--font-body/--ease-out/--dur-short twice (line ~84 and again in the Axion block ~396-409), and body font-family is overridden by the Axion block — consolidate to one :root so Bricolage/Inter tokens are unambiguous.

Unused/legacy font imports: Neue Haas Grotesk Display/Text Pro (lines 2-3) and the .font-instrument Instrument Serif utility — the live system is Bricolage + Inter; drop the dead fonts to cut render-blocking requests.
heroItemSoft's near-duplicate (opacity 0, y:20) of heroItem — merge into one token with a distance parameter instead of two near-identical variants.

The per-section custom ScrollTrigger blocks in lib/scroll-animations.ts (about-title, news-heading, footer each hard-coded opacity+y at slightly different durations 0.9–1s power2/power3) — this is the 'scattered' source; collapse into the surface vocabulary above.
